content_preview.title: SpaceXSI Makes Grok API Text Watermarking Opt-In After Its Documentation Said It Would Be On by Default From November 7, The New Stack Reports
content_preview.summary: The New Stack reports SpaceXSI's Grok API documentation now says text watermarking is off by default and enabled per model by team admins, after earlier versions said it would be on from November 7.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

SpaceXSI's documentation for the Grok API now says text watermarking is off by default, with developers able to enable it for individual models through their team's administration settings, according to [The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/grok-api-watermarking-default/). The outlet reports that an earlier version of the same documentation, which the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine captured on both November 1 and November 6, said watermarking would be on by default starting Nov...

editor_notes.factual_accuracy: Headline, summary and lead hold against The New Stack text and against the live and archived SpaceXSI documentation: the docs now say text watermarking is off by default and enabled per model by team admins; earlier versions (Nov 1, Nov 6 captures) said it would be on by default from November 7. The change date is not asserted beyond The New Stack's attributed Spybara window, which the article says has no stated time zone. 'SpaceXSI' and 'rebranded from SpaceXAI' follow The New Stack's wording; the docs themselves use 'SpaceXSI (xAI)'; the article does not assert any Grok/xAI naming beyond that. Claim-accuracy greps run on headline, summary and body: quantifier/absence sentences checked item by item ('only major AI lab' attributed to The New Stack; 'Both also report' verified for each outlet; 'None of the sources cited here says whether the Commission or any regulator has assessed the revised Grok arrangement' holds for all four sources; 'each report that Anthropic ...' holds for both outlets). Dates: Nov 9 2026 is a Monday and Nov 10 a Tuesday; Timeline order is chronological and every date is attributed to The New Stack. No derived figures other than the Herald's labelled signatory search. One omission found against the primary docs and filed as a clarification: the docs add that 'Some models may be locked on for your team' and cannot be turned off from the Console, and that audio is handled under separate rules; The New Stack does not mention either, and the article's 'opt-in' framing (headline included) is stated without that qualifier.
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral and professional; The New Stack's interpretation of the wording change is explicitly labelled as its reading, not SpaceXSI's. No sensationalism, no AI self-reference beyond the required one-sentence maker disclosure.
editor_notes.originality: New topic. No existing article covers the Grok API watermarking reversal. Related prior coverage: the Oct 8 OpenAI watermarking Briefing and the Nov 1 watermarks Analysis (both linked in the article); linked in article-meta related_articles.
concerns: The reversal rests on one primary independent outlet; the article did not cite SpaceXSI's own documentation, which would have let readers check the current off-by-default setting directly (it confirms The New Stack).
The Insight Partners footer statement could not be read on the article page itself (Cloudflare block); it matches the site's disclosure template on archived pages.
recommendations: Cite the vendor's own documentation page when the story is a change to that page; docs.x.ai has now been allowlisted and is readable as raw markdown by appending .md.
State scope qualifiers found in primary docs (locked-on models) when the headline says 'opt-in'.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Accurate, well-attributed News brief on a developing story; the headline's attribution to The New Stack is faithful, every attributed claim traces to The New Stack, The Decoder or the Commission pages, the quote check passes, and the primary docs corroborate the central claim. One clarification is filed (locked-on models omitted). Verdict APPROVE_WITH_CORRECTIONS. Featured candidacy: 1 - solid, well-sourced update for developers and compliance teams using the Grok API, but a narrow single-vendor settings change rather than a broad-audience story
